cssVars: Primary or destructive action and icon

propDocs.AlertDialog.dismissible: Allow Escape to dismiss the confirmation. Outside presses never dismiss alert dialogs.
propDocs.AlertDialogTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keep a disabled trigger keyboard focusable.
propDocs.AlertDialogClose.variant: Default, primary or destructive action appearance.
propDocs.AlertDialogContent.keepMounted: Keep the closed dialog hidden in the DOM.
